notes.title: Breakthru - Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964533/bff711246b104dd2d642866802fd35ad3309570d.png[/img]

We're excited to announce that Breakthru will officially release on October 25th! 🌟

Prepare to dive into an intense story of survival, loyalty, and sisterhood. When Silas and Leila Nanashiel are wrongfully imprisoned, it's up to Silas to outsmart ruthless guards, make risky deals with other inmates, and find a way to save her sister from an unjust execution.

Will she succeed in breaking Leila out before it's too late? The countdown to freedom begins soon! 🔓✨

Mark your calendars for October 25th ! 🎉
